vuln.name: phpMyAdmin Exposed
vuln.description: A phpMyAdmin installation is reachable on the public interface. It is the web management UI for MySQL/MariaDB and is protected only by its own login.
vuln.impact: Exposing phpMyAdmin invites brute force and exploitation of phpMyAdmin CVEs; a successful login gives full database access. Many installs also leak version and server details.
vuln.recommendation: Do not expose phpMyAdmin publicly. Restrict to a protected network or VPN, require strong credentials, and keep it patched.
